judgments.reason: MNE-BIDS is a software tool for organizing electrophysiological data into BIDS, cited as a BIDS reference; it does not describe this somatomotor dataset.
judgments.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
judgments.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software

judgments.reason: MEG-BIDS is the BIDS extension specification for MEG data, a standard the dataset follows, not a paper describing this somatomotor median nerve dataset.
judgments.paper_title: MEG-BIDS, the brain imaging data structure extended to magnetoencephalography
